patient_actor_hidden.History: The patient's family reports a gradual change in behavior starting a few months ago, which includes inappropriate laughing, using foul language, and occasionally grabbing people without warning. Recently, the patient's memory has also notably deteriorated, leading to difficulty in caring for himself.

Symptoms.Primary_Symptom: Change in behavior including inappropriate actions
Secondary_Symptoms: Trouble taking care of personal needs

patient_actor_hidden.Past_Medical_History: No significant past medical or psychiatric history. No history of alcohol or substance abuse.
patient_actor_hidden.Social_History: Recently retired, lives with a spouse. Non-smoker, drinks alcohol socially. No history of legal or financial issues.
patient_actor_hidden.Review_of_Systems: Denies headache, visual changes, seizures, muscle weakness, or other neurological symptoms.

objective_for_doctor: Assess and diagnose the patient presenting with changes in behavior and memory over the past few months.

turns.doctor_opening: Hello, what brings you in today? Could you tell me about yourself and what's been going on?
turns.patient_opening: “Well, over the past few months my behavior has changed—I’ve been acting inappropriately, laughing when I shouldn’t, sometimes using foul language, and occasionally grabbing people without warning. My memory has also been getting worse, so I’m having trouble taking care of my personal needs, and I’ve noticed some difficulty finding words.”

turns.doctor_question: Do you have any small, raised bumps on your skin that have a tiny indentation or a "dimple" in the center?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed any small raised bumps on my skin or anything with a tiny dimple in the center. I’d be happy to show you my skin areas if you want, but nothing like that has come up for me.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed that you need to urinate more often than usual?
turns.patient_answer: “Not really—I've not noticed needing to urinate more often than usual, but I can tell you if any changes come up.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you been feeling generally weak or lacking your usual strength lately?
turns.patient_answer: “I don’t feel particularly weak or lacking my usual strength. It’s mostly been the behavior changes and worsening memory, along with some trouble with word finding.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any rashes, bumps, or sores appearing specifically along the veins in your arms?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t had any rashes, bumps, or sores showing up along the veins in my arms, and I haven’t noticed anything like that. I mainly just have the behavior changes, worsening memory, and trouble finding words.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you been experiencing any itchiness on your skin?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t had any itchiness on my skin or any unusual skin symptoms. It’s mostly the inappropriate behavior, worsening memory, and trouble finding words that have been concerning me.”

turns.doctor_question: Do you experience any pain or cramping in your calf muscles when you walk that feels better once you stop and rest?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I don’t get any pain or cramping in my calf muscles when I walk, and it doesn’t seem to improve when I stop and rest. My main issues have been the gradual behavior changes, worsening memory, and difficulty finding words.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed if your stools have become unusually pale, light-colored, or clay-colored recently?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed any unusually pale, light-colored, or clay-colored stools. My main concerns are still the gradual behavior changes, worsening memory, and trouble finding words.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any weakness in your hands, such as difficulty gripping objects or opening jars?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed any weakness in my hands—no trouble gripping things or opening jars. It’s mostly the changes in my behavior, getting worse memory, and trouble finding the right words.”

turns.doctor_question: During these shaking episodes, are you able to remain conscious and aware of your surroundings, or do you lose consciousness?
turns.patient_answer: “I haven’t had any shaking episodes—nothing like that—so I can’t say whether I lose consciousness. What’s been most noticeable is the gradual behavior changes, worsening memory, and trouble finding the right words.”

turns.doctor_question: Are you currently experiencing any pain or discomfort in your abdominal area?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I’m not having any pain or discomfort in my abdominal area. My main issues have been the gradual behavior changes, worsening memory, and trouble finding words.”

turns.doctor_question: Are you experiencing any shortness of breath or finding it difficult to breathe normally?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I’m not experiencing shortness of breath or any difficulty breathing normally. My main issue is still the gradual behavior changes, worsening memory, and trouble finding words.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you been in contact with anyone else who has a similar rash or skin lesions?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed any rash or skin lesions, so I can’t say I’ve been in contact with anyone who has something similar. My concern has been mainly the gradual behavior changes, worsening memory, and trouble finding words.”
